@@U04310@@
scary, too.
One man stayed standing, another fell.
You groped along blindly and struck, and for
every stoke an enemy went down.
It was like a veil covering your eyes,
and then humming and hissing and
buzzing in your ears.
And so it went,
and now we're here, and none of us
knows how it happened.

@@U04311@@
(Enter the EMPEROR with four PRINCES. The GUARDS withdraw.)

@@U04313@@
Magic or no, it is what it is!
We've won!
The fleeing enemy scattered across the plain.
Look here, the empty throne, the traitor’s treasures.
I now await the arrival of foreign emissaries,
and news that the Empire is again at peace
and loyal to the crown.
There may have been trickery involved, but in the end
we fought our own battle and won it.
Accidents happen,
accidents that work in one’s favor:
a meteor falls from the sky,
blood rains down on the foe,
and from mountain caverns blasts of miraculous sound
that rouse our spirits but utterly confound the enemy.
The loser fell, the object of scorn;
the victor rises, in triumph thanking his God!
But not he alone, a million throats
sing out in one voice:
Te deum laudamus.
But now I'll do what I’ve seldom done.
Look within. A young and lively prince may
squander his days, but time, in the end,
teaches him to value them.
translation:
@@U04310@@
也很可怕。
一个人站着，另一个人倒下了。
你盲目地摸索和打击，为了
每击一次，就有一个敌人倒下。
就好像一层面纱遮住了你的眼睛，
然后嗡嗡作响，嘶嘶作响
在你耳边嗡嗡作响。
就这样，
现在我们在这里，但我们谁也没有
知道这是怎么发生的。

@@U04311@@
（皇帝携四王子上。侍卫退去。）

@@U04313@@
神奇与否，它就是这样！
我们赢了！
逃跑的敌人散落在平原上。
看这里，空荡荡的王座，叛徒的宝藏。
我现在等待外国使者的到来，
以及帝国再次和平的消息
并且忠于王室。
可能有一些诡计，但最终
我们打了自己的仗并赢得了胜利。
意外时有发生，
对某人有利的事故：
一颗流星从天而降，
鲜血如雨点落在敌人身上，
山洞里传出神奇的声音
振奋我们的斗志，却彻底迷惑敌人。
失败者倒下，成为嘲笑的对象；
胜利者站起来，胜利地感谢他的上帝！
但不是他一个人，有一百万个喉咙
齐声唱出：
感谢赞美。
但现在我会做我很少做的事情。
向内看。年轻活泼的王子可能
浪费了他的日子，但时间，最终，
教他珍惜它们。
